milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak fence pen structure is centered at spawn-relative (5, 1, 4) — a 3x3 double-height fence pen with a torch beacon on top. The player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they've found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure rather than having their back turned.

Uses inventory_has because crafting birch_planks results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 4 birch_log (via /give) and 0 birch_planks, so any birch_planks in inventory proves crafting occurred. 1 birch_log yields 4 birch_planks in a 2x2 inventory grid (no crafting table needed). min_count=1 is the minimum threshold to confirm the craft action happened.

Uses inventory_has because crafting mushroom_stew results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must complete the full crafting chain: birch_planks → bowl (3 planks at crafting table at ~5,~0,~7), then collect red_mushroom (on mycelium at ~3,~0,~2) and brown_mushroom (on mycelium at ~7,~0,~2), and combine bowl + both mushrooms at the crafting table. Since mushroom_stew cannot be obtained any other way in this scene, its presence in inventory conclusively proves the entire dependency chain was completed.
